turns.assessment: The failure is isolated to svc341: svc055 has the same endpoints and working route, while many other services using each constituent lightpath remain healthy. Stable line-interface and optical measurements strongly exclude fibre, amplifier, ROADM-channel, and line-interface faults. The paired ODU_TIM alarms point most strongly to a service-specific ODU cross-connect misconnection, but the evidence does not identify which OTN switch; a client-port failure is a weaker alternative.

proposals.rationale: A wrong cross-connect can misroute one ODU without any optical change, matching the isolation to svc341 and the simultaneous ODU_TIM alarms at both endpoints. Healthy svc055 on the identical optical route rules out a shared transport-path failure.

A failure of either svc341 client port could interrupt only this service and lead to endpoint client alarms. It is less consistent than misrouting because CLIENT_PORT_FAIL directly explains CLIENT_DOWN but not paired ODU_TIM at both ends.
An OTN switch lies in the relevant layer, but a fabric failure should interrupt every ODU passing through it; the numerous healthy neighboring services strongly contradict that scope.

score.why: truth not in the reported set
